Subject: Changes to On-Call Rotation Starting June 2

Hi team,

We're changing how our on-call rotation works. Starting June 2, shifts will last 3 days instead of a full week.

Many of you have told us that week-long shifts are exhausting, especially when incidents pile up late in the week. Shorter shifts should help with fatigue, make it easier to plan your personal time, and keep response quality steady across the whole shift.

There are 9 engineers in the rotation pool, so each of you will be on call about once every 27 days. You'll be on call more often than before, but each shift will be much shorter. You'll also get a $150 bonus for each shift you complete.

The updated schedule will be posted in the team calendar by the end of next week. Please check your assigned dates as soon as it's up. If you have conflicts, arrange swaps with a teammate and let your manager know at least 48 hours before the shift starts.

If you have questions or concerns, reply to this email or bring them to our next team sync.

Thanks for keeping our systems running smoothly.

Best,
[Your Name]
Engineering Operations
